records.issue_text: catch around sendAddGuestsEmails swallows the error and logs only a static string, discarding err and making failures invisible in production
records.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `sendAddGuestsEmails` is wrapped in `try { ... } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }`, which swallows the exception and logs only a static string without the `err` details. The diff shows this makes email delivery failures hard to detect/debug in production, even if the mutation otherwise succeeds.

records.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, existing attendees are checked in a prior read (`findFirst` including `attendees`) and then new rows are inserted later via `prisma.booking.update({ data: { attendees: { createMany: ... }}})`.
